de:Aufgenommen bei Nacht auf den Dächern: Shot at night on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, the film reveals in detail the systems behind Israel's targeted mass killing of Palestinian civilians in the Gaza Strip.
de:Das Drama dreht sich um den Absturz v: The drama revolves around the crash of Swissair Flight 111 into the cold waters of the Atlantic Ocean off the coast of Halifax, Nova Scotia, on September 2, 1998. The crash separates people and brings others together. It ends lives and changes destinies.
de:Der hoffnungslose Romantiker Bear nut: Hopeless romantic Bear uses a one-wish willow to win his crush Nikki. This magical item fulfills wishes when broken. But he quickly realizes with horror that the wish takes an uncanny toll.
de:Die optimistische Studentin Lena über: Optimistic student Lena takes over a writing course – her only participant is Hugo Drowak, a bitter, drinking misanthropist. He once wrote love poems full of passion until a disappointment drove him into alcohol and isolation. Despite his meanness, Lena does not give up: she firmly believes that every person deserves a second chance, and tries to rekindle Hugo's creativity.
de:Ein Abend voller grosser und kleiner: An evening full of big and small waves, breathtaking nature and lots of girl power! What happens when women leave behind classic role models and only follow their dreams? Find out in our Gutsy Girls Double Feature!   GUTS - A FEMALE EXPEDITION THROUGH AFRICA   (FR, 2025. de:England, Juni 1944: Unter dem Oberbef: England, June 1944: Under the command of US General Dwight D. Eisenhower (Brendan Fraser), the largest naval invasion in history is imminent. But whether the Allied landing in Normandy succeeds depends on a single, unpredictable variable: the weather. In the crucial 72 hours before D-Day, British Chief Meteorologist Captain James Stagg (Andrew Scott) must make the most consequential weather forecast of his life
de:Jahre, nachdem er die Polizei berlis: Years after outwitting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new clue threatens to reveal his secret. When the investigation resumes, he must outwit the system again to save his family.
de:Nach Jahren schlampiger Fortsetzungen: After years of sloppy sequels and a dwindling fan base, the ambitious, queer filmmaker Kris is set to revive the slasher film series Camp Miasma with a remake. She meets the Final Girl of the first film, the mysterious and eccentric lead actress Billy Preston.
